name: Venn circles
what: Two glowing circles, each with a word, on a dark ground: the rings draw themselves, the circles drift apart, rush together until they overlap like a Venn diagram, then breathe closer and farther while the words swell with them and each letter wiggles.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f2-f28 each ring draws itself as an arc chasing its tail while the word fades up (f5-f30); f12-f45 the circles drift apart and grow slowly (r 139 to 172); f45-f66 they rush together and grow (r 172 to 259, a 515 px gap down to 445 px) so they overlap from f58; f66-f120 they shrink and draw closer (r 259 to 220); f120-f177 they open out and grow back to r 259; the words follow the circles' size, each letter wiggling a little

tracks.name: rings draw
tracks.what: each ring draws itself as an arc chasing its own tail

tracks.name: words in
tracks.what: the words fade up inside the rings

tracks.name: drift apart
tracks.what: the circles grow slowly and drift a little apart

tracks.name: rush together
tracks.what: the circles grow fast and rush toward each other until they overlap

tracks.name: breathe in
tracks.what: the circles shrink and draw closer

tracks.name: breathe out
tracks.what: the circles open out and grow back to the full overlap
